item.title: Yume no Ukihashi ~Shinshaku Genji Monogatari~ Wakamurasaki Yuugao Suetsumuhana Hen
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mugen Touhi Kyuusuu
  • 発売日: 2009-12-30
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 夢の浮橋～新釈源氏物語～ 若紫・夕顔・末摘花編
  • 英語名: Yume no Ukihashi Shinshaku Genji Monogatari Wakamurasaki Yuugao Suetsumuhana Hen

别名

  • 夢の浮橋２

あらすじ

This game is an eroge based on “The Tale of Genji.”

It keeps the original story’s depth and diverse characters but has been updated to appeal to modern audiences.

The protagonist, Hikaru Genji, is born as a prince of the Heian Emperor.
